title: fund_wallet RPC missing from version-controlled migrations
description: capture-order.js calls fund_wallet RPC but no SQL migration exists in supabase/sql/
why_blocks: PayPal capture succeeds but wallet credit fails unless RPC applied manually outside repo
recommended_fix: Add fund_wallet SQL migration aligned with wallet_balance and transaction insert

title: balance vs wallet_balance column split
description: transfer_funds uses balance; create_withdrawal_request uses wallet_balance
why_blocks: Users may see incorrect balances; send and withdraw operate on different columns
recommended_fix: Unify to single column migrate all RPCs backfill data

title: KYC enforcement advisory-only by default
description: Funding and send have no server KYC hard blocks; withdrawal RPC bypassable
why_blocks: Regulated live-money requires enforced identity verification before money movement
recommended_fix: Enable hard_block mode; add KYC gate to withdrawal RPC and fund/send APIs

title: No sanctions/PEP screening or SAR workflow
description: AML policy pages are placeholders; no vendor or SAR process
why_blocks: Required for MSB/fintech compliance before handling customer funds
recommended_fix: Integrate sanctions vendor; implement SAR case workflow

title: fraud_logs RLS allows all authenticated users
description: fraud_logs policies use USING (true) for any authenticated user
why_blocks: Fraud data leak and tampering risk by malicious users
recommended_fix: Replace with admin-only RLS via tc_is_admin()

title: Single hardcoded admin email RBAC
description: ADMIN_EMAILS hardcoded in adminAccess.js and tc_is_admin() SQL
why_blocks: Not scalable; no role separation for ops/compliance/treasury
recommended_fix: Move to env/DB-backed roles table with granular permissions

title: Legal documents are draft placeholders
description: Terms privacy AML KYC risk disclosure marked draft in audit tooling
why_blocks: Cannot launch externally without legally reviewed policies
recommended_fix: Complete legal review update pages track version/effective date

title: Send money bypasses server-side gates
description: send-money.jsx calls transfer_funds RPC without server KYC/fraud checks
why_blocks: Client trust layer bypassable; high-risk transfers possible
recommended_fix: Add POST /api/send/check-limit mirroring withdrawal gate

title: PayPal defaults to sandbox mode
description: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYPAL_MODE unset defaults to sandbox
why_blocks: Real money cannot flow without explicit live cutover
recommended_fix: Live PayPal cutover checklist; fail deploy if sandbox in production

title: No .env.example or deployment runbook
description: Zero env template files; README is boilerplate
why_blocks: Deployment errors and secret omissions in production
recommended_fix: Add .env.example with all public vs server vars

title: 2FA/MFA not enforced
description: security_settings schema exists but 2FA not enforced in app
why_blocks: Required for production OAuth wallet and financial security
recommended_fix: Implement TOTP/SMS 2FA with enforcement for financial actions

title: Account security guard fail-open
description: serverAccountSecurityGuard allows if account_security_status missing
why_blocks: Frozen accounts may perform financial actions during migration gaps
recommended_fix: Fail-closed for financial actions when status unverified

title: Internal ledger not connected to money flows
description: Ledger observation-only; no auto-posting from fund/withdraw/send
why_blocks: Cannot reconcile treasury or produce auditable financial statements
recommended_fix: Wire journal entries to money RPCs or designate transactions as SOA

title: No external APM or alerting
description: No Sentry Datadog PagerDuty or uptime monitoring
why_blocks: Production incidents may go undetected
recommended_fix: Add Sentry uptime checks PagerDuty/Slack alerts

title: No production webhook delivery pipeline
description: Only developer.test events; signing key mismatch for verifier
why_blocks: Third-party integrators cannot receive real events
recommended_fix: Build delivery worker with encrypted secret storage and retries

title: Legacy tropicash-api Python sidecar
description: tropicash-api/main.py exposes wallet mutations with API_SECRET_KEY
why_blocks: Parallel path bypasses Next.js security if deployed
recommended_fix: Remove or isolate behind internal network

title: Transaction type mismatch send vs send_money
description: transfer_funds inserts send but fraud queries send_money
why_blocks: Fraud correlation may miss send transactions
recommended_fix: Standardize on send_money across RPC and queries

title: No CSRF protection on API routes
description: No CSRF tokens on state-changing routes
why_blocks: XSS/CSRF risk for browser-initiated requests
recommended_fix: Add CSRF tokens for browser API calls

title: No security headers CSP HSTS
description: next.config.mjs only sets poweredByHeader false
why_blocks: Reduced defense-in-depth against XSS
recommended_fix: Add helmet-style headers in next.config.mjs

title: SDK not published to npm
description: @tropicash/sdk private UNLICENSED no CI tests
why_blocks: External developers cannot install official SDK
recommended_fix: Publish to npm with TypeScript types and tests

title: No email/push notification delivery
description: In-app only; no FCM or transactional email
why_blocks: Users miss alerts when offline
recommended_fix: Add SendGrid/Resend email optional FCM push

title: PWA offline shell only
description: Service worker excludes wallet/API routes
why_blocks: Limited mobile app-like experience
recommended_fix: Accept as v1 limitation or expand offline

title: QR payments not implemented
description: No QR generation scanning or payment flows
why_blocks: Feature gap not required for wallet-only Private Alpha
recommended_fix: Defer to post-Private Alpha roadmap

title: Payment links not implemented
description: No shareable checkout URLs
why_blocks: Feature gap defer unless required for launch
recommended_fix: Implement after merchant checkout foundation

title: Merchant checkout simulation only
description: Developer catalog has planned contracts only
why_blocks: External merchant integrations not possible
recommended_fix: Phase 5 roadmap; not blocking wallet Private Alpha

title: No scheduled report exports
description: Reporting read-only admin UI no CSV/PDF export
why_blocks: Operational inconvenience not launch blocker
recommended_fix: Add export endpoints for reconciliation reports
